briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Infosys, 17 November 2026

**Summary:** Infosys's second quarter (ended 30 September) showed slower growth, a lower revenue outlook, and weakness in North America, though AI revenue and large deal wins grew. Investor-relations activity and campus expansion continued in late October and early November.

**Financial results and outlook**
- Q2 revenue was $5,145 million, with AI revenue up 29% sequentially to 10.5% of revenue. Reported revenue rose 1.3% year over year, and operating margin was 21.0% (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/INFY/infosys-differentiated-ai-strategy-and-a-sharp-focus-on-value-unlock-sjalje8xfokm.html).
- Infosys cut its annual revenue growth guidance, and its ADR fell over 7% on 23 October (https://upstox.com/news/market-news/stocks/infosys-adr-falls-over-7-as-it-major-lowers-annual-revenue-growth-guidance-everything-investors-need-to-know/article-202325).
- Net profit rose 6.2% to 78.23 billion rupees but missed the 79.29 billion rupee analyst expectation. Deal wins rose to $5.2 billion from $3.1 a year earlier. Weakness among North American hi-tech and retail clients was cited (https://www.thestar.com.my/tech/tech-news/2026/10/23/india039s-infosys-beats-second-quarter-revenue-view).
- Shares fell 6.5% on 27 October after Q2 EPS missed estimates by $0.01 (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108).
- BMO Capital raised its price target to $13 and kept a Market Perform rating on 26 October (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108).
- Infosys reported North America revenue decline amid sector slowdowns on 23 October (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108).

**Deals and large contracts**
- Large-deal total contract value reached $5.2 billion, 62% of it net new, including one deal above $2 billion (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/INFY/infosys-differentiated-ai-strategy-and-a-sharp-focus-on-value-unlock-sjalje8xfokm.html).

**Hiring and capacity**
- Infosys expanded its Truist GCC in India and onboarded 1,000 colleagues on 19 October (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108).
- A new 1.1 million sq ft block opened at the Pocharam campus in Hyderabad to serve emerging technologies (https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/hyderabad/infosys-sets-up-new-1-1m-sq-ft-block-at-pocharam-campus-in-hyderabad-to-cater-to-emerging-technologies/articleshow/135366954.cms).
- A Hyderabad campus expansion was inaugurated on 2 November, attended by Telangana Deputy Chief Minister Mallu Bhatti Vikramarka, IT Minister Duddilla Sridhar Babu, and CFO Jayesh Sanghrajka. The facility targets banking, retail, life sciences, and manufacturing clients and includes radiant cooling and rainwater harvesting (https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/infosys-shares-slide-over-2-hyderabad-campus-expansion-fails-to-lift-sentiment/article71655856.ece). Shares slid over 2% that day (same source).
- Infosys employs over 325,000 people across 59 countries (https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/infosys-shares-slide-over-2-hyderabad-campus-expansion-fails-to-lift-sentiment/article71655856.ece).

**Investor relations and other events**
- Management will attend non-deal investor roadshows in London and Edinburgh in November (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108).
- A block trade worth ₹69.49 crore was executed on the NSE on 23 October (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108).
- The Infosys Prize 2026 was announced on 12 November in Bengaluru, with six researchers each receiving $100,000. This is a foundation award, not a company business event (https://news.careers360.com/infosys-prize-2026-scholars-from-tifr-princeton-carnegie-mellon-uc-san-ranscisco-new-south-wales-singapore-universities-winners).

**Background (undated source)**
- Headquarters in Bangalore; founded 1981; IT services and consulting; B2B model (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/Gbd7vUUlzCYP).

**Gaps:** I found no news dated 13–17 November and no product launch announcements. Several items are headlines only, without full text.

**Open questions**
1. What is the outlook for North American demand, and how much of the guidance cut reflects client project scaling-down versus AI-related spending shifts (https://www.thestar.com.my/tech/tech-news/2026/10/23/india039s-infosys-beats-second-quarter-revenue-view)?
2. Can AI revenue (10.5% of Q2 revenue) keep growing at the recent pace, and how much of the $5.2 billion deal pipeline is expected to convert to revenue in the next two quarters (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/INFY/infosys-differentiated-ai-strategy-and-a-sharp-focus-on-value-unlock-sjalje8xfokm.html)?
3. Now that the Hyderabad and Pocharam capacity is in place, what hiring and utilization plans follow, and how will the GCC model (such as the Truist expansion) be scaled (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108)?
